// ---- GENERATED BY QEDGEN — DO NOT EDIT ---- spec-hash:850c058a868a03be
use pinocchio::program_error::ProgramError;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(u32)]
pub enum VaultError {
    InvalidAmount = 0,
    MathOverflow = 1,
    MathUnderflow = 2,
    InvalidLifecycle = 3,
}

impl From<VaultError> for ProgramError {
    fn from(e: VaultError) -> Self {
        ProgramError::Custom(e as u32)
    }
}
// ---- END GENERATED ----

// ---- GENERATED BY QEDGEN — DO NOT EDIT — regenerated from .qedspec ----
//! Per-handler guard checks derived from the `.qedspec` (Pinocchio).

#![allow(
    unused_variables,
    unused_imports,
    dead_code,
    clippy::too_many_arguments
)]

use crate::errors::*;
use crate::instructions::*;
use crate::state::*;
use pinocchio::{account_info::AccountInfo, program_error::ProgramError, ProgramResult};
use zeropod::ZeroPodFixed;

/// Guards for `deposit` — generated from the spec's `requires` / `auth` clauses.
pub fn deposit(ctx: &Deposit, amount: u64) -> ProgramResult {
    // requires: amount > 0
    if !(amount > 0) {
        return Err(ProgramError::from(VaultError::InvalidAmount));
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// Guards for `withdraw` — generated from the spec's `requires` / `auth` clauses.
pub fn withdraw(ctx: &Withdraw, amount: u64) -> ProgramResult {
    // requires: amount > 0
    if !(amount > 0) {
        return Err(ProgramError::from(VaultError::InvalidAmount));
    }
    Ok(())
}

--- src/instructions/deposit.rs ---
// User-owned. Regenerating the spec does NOT overwrite this file.
// Guard checks live in the sibling `crate::guards` module and ARE
// regenerated on every `qedgen codegen`.

use crate::errors::*;
use crate::guards;
use crate::state::*;
use pinocchio::{account_info::AccountInfo, program_error::ProgramError, ProgramResult};
use zeropod::ZeroPodFixed;

pub struct Deposit<'a> {
    pub state: &'a AccountInfo,
    pub depositor: &'a AccountInfo,
}

impl Deposit<'_> {
    pub fn handler(&mut self, amount: u64) -> ProgramResult {
        guards::deposit(self, amount)?;
        let __state =
            VaultAccount::from_bytes_mut(unsafe { self.state.borrow_mut_data_unchecked() })
                .map_err(|_| ProgramError::InvalidAccountData)?;
        __state.total = __state
            .total
            .get()
            .checked_add(amount)
            .ok_or(ProgramError::from(VaultError::MathOverflow))?
            .into();
        Ok(())
    }
}

/// Entrypoint wrapper — binds the account slice + parses params, then
/// calls `Deposit::handler`. Invoked by `process_instruction` in lib.rs.
pub fn process_deposit(accounts: &[AccountInfo], instruction_data: &[u8]) -> ProgramResult {
    let [state, depositor, ..] = accounts else {
        return Err(ProgramError::NotEnoughAccountKeys);
    };
    let amount = u64::from_le_bytes(
        instruction_data
            .get(0..8)
            .ok_or(ProgramError::InvalidInstructionData)?
            .try_into()
            .map_err(|_| ProgramError::InvalidInstructionData)?,
    );
    let mut ctx = Deposit { state, depositor };
    ctx.handler(amount)
}

--- src/instructions/withdraw.rs ---
// User-owned. Regenerating the spec does NOT overwrite this file.
// Guard checks live in the sibling `crate::guards` module and ARE
// regenerated on every `qedgen codegen`.

use crate::errors::*;
use crate::guards;
use crate::state::*;
use pinocchio::{account_info::AccountInfo, program_error::ProgramError, ProgramResult};
use zeropod::ZeroPodFixed;

pub struct Withdraw<'a> {
    pub state: &'a AccountInfo,
    pub vault_ta: &'a AccountInfo,
    pub owner_ta: &'a AccountInfo,
    pub auth: &'a AccountInfo,
    pub token_program: &'a AccountInfo,
}

impl Withdraw<'_> {
    pub fn handler(&mut self, amount: u64) -> ProgramResult {
        guards::withdraw(self, amount)?;
        let __state =
            VaultAccount::from_bytes_mut(unsafe { self.state.borrow_mut_data_unchecked() })
                .map_err(|_| ProgramError::InvalidAccountData)?;
        __state.total = __state
            .total
            .get()
            .checked_sub(amount)
            .ok_or(ProgramError::from(VaultError::MathUnderflow))?
            .into();
        // Spec call: Token.transfer
        pinocchio_token::instructions::Transfer {
            from: self.vault_ta,
            to: self.owner_ta,
            authority: self.auth,
            amount: amount,
        }
        .invoke()?;
        // Spec event: emit Withdrawn — agent fill
        todo!("fill non-mechanical effects, events, transfers, calls")
    }
}

/// Entrypoint wrapper — binds the account slice + parses params, then
/// calls `Withdraw::handler`. Invoked by `process_instruction` in lib.rs.
pub fn process_withdraw(accounts: &[AccountInfo], instruction_data: &[u8]) -> ProgramResult {
    let [state, vault_ta, owner_ta, auth, token_program, ..] = accounts else {
        return Err(ProgramError::NotEnoughAccountKeys);
    };
    let amount = u64::from_le_bytes(
        instruction_data
            .get(0..8)
            .ok_or(ProgramError::InvalidInstructionData)?
            .try_into()
            .map_err(|_| ProgramError::InvalidInstructionData)?,
    );
    let mut ctx = Withdraw {
        state,
        vault_ta,
        owner_ta,
        auth,
        token_program,
    };
    ctx.handler(amount)
}

--- src/lib.rs ---
// ---- GENERATED BY QEDGEN — DO NOT EDIT ---- spec-hash:0c69b72307144678
#![allow(unexpected_cfgs)]
#![cfg_attr(any(target_os = "solana", target_arch = "bpf"), no_std)]

use pinocchio::{account_info::AccountInfo, program_error::ProgramError, ProgramResult};

pub mod errors;
pub mod events;
pub mod guards;
mod instructions;
pub mod state;
#[cfg(kani)]
extern crate kani;
#[cfg(kani)]
mod kani_impl;

pinocchio_pubkey::declare_id!("11111111111111111111111111111111");

use pinocchio::entrypoint;
entrypoint!(process_instruction);

/// Instruction dispatch — the leading byte of `instruction_data`
/// selects the handler (discriminant = declaration order).
pub fn process_instruction(
    _program_id: &pinocchio::pubkey::Pubkey,
    accounts: &[AccountInfo],
    instruction_data: &[u8],
) -> ProgramResult {
    let (discriminant, data) = instruction_data
        .split_first()
        .ok_or(ProgramError::InvalidInstructionData)?;
    match *discriminant {
        0 => instructions::deposit::process_deposit(accounts, data),
        1 => instructions::withdraw::process_withdraw(accounts, data),
        _ => Err(ProgramError::InvalidInstructionData),
    }
}

use zeropod::ZeroPod;

/// Status lifecycle states.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]

pub enum Status {
    Active = 0,
}

#[derive(ZeroPod)]
